test_ValidObjectFile: test SPIR-V object file generation with valid preamble and zero return code
test_ValidAssemblyFile: test SPIR-V assembly file generation with correct header comments and no output
test_ErrorMessage: test that a command fails with a specific expected error message on stderr
test_ValidObjectFileWithAssemblySubstr: test SPIR-V binary disassembly contains a specified substring per input
test_ExecutedListOfPasses: test that a list of spirv-opt passes were executed in expected order
